title: B7 Signed-Only UDP 9092 Discovery Handshake, LAN Credential Hygiene, and Architectural Ratchet
goal: Remove plaintext host_token broadcast from crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/amas.rs so LAN discovery broadcasts only HMAC-signed SUSI_PING_SIG frames, update crates/susi-gawd/src/kernel_loader.rs to probe UDP 9092 with cluster_key::signed_ping and verify_signed_pong, and add tests/authenticated_discovery_b7.rs ratcheting the B7 invariant across server.rs, kernel_loader.rs, and amas.rs.
